issue_title: Repo Marketing Agent — Weekly Campaign Pack
portfolio_message: I build browser games, reusable game systems, read-only dashboards, and developer tools with controlled patches, clear documentation, and smoke-backed workflows.
campaign_goal: Turn repository activity into honest, proof-based portfolio marketing without exaggerating project maturity.

DungeonDex.positioning: A mobile-focused browser dungeon crawler developed through narrow, versioned, smoke-backed patches.
DungeonDex.audience: players, browser-game developers, and systems-design recruiters

depth-engine.positioning: A no-build HTML, CSS, and JavaScript RPG foundation designed to be copied, studied, and reshaped.
depth-engine.audience: indie developers and people learning browser-game architecture

merge-guard.positioning: A diff and pull-request risk scanner that explains likely breakage areas and the checks worth running before merge.
merge-guard.audience: solo developers and small teams using GitHub

dev-kit.positioning: A Python toolkit for read-only repository audits, version-label checks, and release-hygiene reports.
dev-kit.audience: maintainers who want safer, repeatable releases

crypto-analyst.positioning: A mock-first crypto analysis dashboard centered on invalidation, scenario review, and capital-preservation labels—not trade execution.
crypto-analyst.audience: frontend developers and risk-focused market analysts

alchemy-game.positioning: An ingredient-discovery browser game built around experimentation, recipes, and potion outcomes.
alchemy-game.audience: players who enjoy crafting and discovery systems

guildmasters.positioning: A compact browser guild-management loop with recruiting, contracts, upgrades, and persistent progress.

crafting-kit.positioning: Validation and dry-run helpers for safer crafting-system design.
crafting-kit.audience: game developers building item and recipe systems

DungeonDex3D.positioning: A focused React and Three.js graybox exploring first-person dungeon interaction and encounter UI.
DungeonDex3D.audience: web-3D developers and technical game-design recruiters

repair-tool-kit.positioning: Safety-first repair workflows and maintenance checklists for controlled troubleshooting sessions.
